//overrides: drizzle-kit depends on the deprecated @esbuild-kit/* packages, which pin an
esbuild older than 0.25 — the version with GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 (any website
can issue requests to esbuild's DEV SERVER and read the response).
drizzle-kit is a devDependency and never starts that dev server, so nothing
here was actually exposed. It is overridden anyway so `npm audit` stays
clean and a real advisory is never buried under a known-noisy one.
npm's own suggested fix is `drizzle-kit@0.18.1` — a DOWNGRADE from 0.31.10
that predates the `dialect`/`url` config this project uses, and would break
every migration. Do not run `npm audit fix --force` here.
